title: YouTube Channel Scraper Output
description: Scraped YouTube channel data including subscriber metrics, influencer tier, recent videos, and optional thumbnails.

channelResults.title: Channel Results
channelResults.description: All scraped YouTube channels stored in the default dataset. Each item contains channel name, handle, subscribers, influencer tier, total views, recent videos, and more.

thumbnails.title: Thumbnails
thumbnails.description: Profile pictures and video thumbnails downloaded to the key-value store. Only populated when the 'downloadThumbnails' input option is enabled.
